summary: Cylindrical brushed DC planetary gear motor with a 36 mm diameter gearbox and body, and an 8 mm REX output shaft protruding from the gearbox face. The motor axis is along z, with the shaft at +z.

mountingSurfaces.description: Gearbox output face, from which the 8 mm REX shaft (about 23.5 mm long) extends in +z. This face is used for direct attachment of goBILDA components. The mounting hole pattern is not dimensioned in the drawings.

36 mm diameter cylindrical gearbox and body surface, which can be clamped by a 36 mm bore clamping mount (shown in the images). Clamping is on the cylindrical surface, so the offset applies along the motor axis.

notes: Only the 36 mm diameter, the 8 mm shaft and the 23.5 mm shaft length are stated. The listed length of 24 mm appears to be the shaft length, not the body length. The total z length of about 138 mm is an estimate from the image proportions, with a body of about 114.5 mm plus the shaft, and should be verified. The bounding box is centered on the part with the shaft at +z. Hole positions are left empty because no hole pattern dimensions are given. Wires and connectors are excluded from the bounds.
